chunks: "Whoever performs the Maghrib salat (prayer) in a state of fear with a group, he performs one rak'ah with the first group and two rak'ahs with the second group."

key_terms.الطَّائِفَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ: the second party or group praying behind the leader
key_terms.الطَّائِفَةِ الْأُولَى: the first party or group praying behind the leader
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبَ: the Maghrib salat (prayer), the sunset prayer
key_terms.بِالْقَوْمِ: with the group or people being led in prayer
key_terms.خَوْفٍ: a state of fear or danger requiring special prayer arrangement

ai.seo_question: How is Maghrib salat performed in a situation of fear with two groups?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for performing Salat al-Maghrib in Salat al-Khawf during circumstances of fear. It explains how the Imam leading the prayer divides the rak'ahs between two groups, preserving both communal worship and caution in a dangerous situation.
